name: crack-bot
description: crack-bot: fast live-DOM computer use for Grok Bot. Decides with TypeSafe Jev through Vercel AI Gateway and clicks the observed node; no screenshot loop.

interface.shortDescription: Fast live-DOM web tasks instead of slow screenshot computer use.
interface.longDescription: crack-bot is the Bot's fast hands for the web. Give fast_web_task the whole goal plus everything you already know in data; it reads the live page, decides each step in ~0.5s with TypeSafe Jev, and clicks or types on the real DOM node. Fills forms from data with no round trips, routes multi-hop browsing itself, and asks you (need_text / need_decision) only when a decision needs a planner. Attaches to this agent's Chrome when remote debugging is enabled. Requires AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY.
defaultPrompt: For web tasks call fast_web_task once with the whole goal and its stop condition. Put every value you already know in data. Do not screenshot-click pages with HTML controls.
Answer need_text with fast_web_fill and need_decision with fast_web_choose. Do not restart the task while one is waiting.
Fill in this listing form with the provided data and save the draft.
